recognitionSource: Construction, layering, disciplined utility geometry, cropped waist rhythm, color relationship, and modest original regiment-style insignia where rarity permits.

interpretations.paired pocket flaps: military_repeat or a short upper-chest paired geometry
interpretations.epaulettes: shoulder_block or yoke continuation, never detached marks
interpretations.harness rhythm: one paired/diagonal or waist-level geometry, never a body-wide mesh
interpretations.leather trim: dark accent role on one construction-bound trim system
interpretations.cropped waist: structured or contrast hem plus compact jacket mass
interpretations.split-wing crest: a modest asymmetric star-derived badge used as original regiment homage, never an exact faction mark
interpretations.shoulder patch: a small asymmetric-front motif with a one/two-cell side continuation

rarityTranslation.Common: One calm but visible field-world design idea; attractive everyday clothing with a low complexity ceiling.
rarityTranslation.Uncommon: Two coordinated systems with a structured panel/utility identity and optional small badge; moderate ceiling and clear gameplay-size thematic read.
rarityTranslation.Rare: Three controlled systems: one strong primary composition, one substantial secondary region, one modest focal/accent treatment, and coordinated finishing. Preserve unused space for future Legendary/Mythic tiers.

Uncommon.insigniaPolicy: small chest or shoulder badge permitted
Uncommon.intent: definitely belongs to the AoT-inspired pool

Rare.insigniaPolicy: modest original focal crest permitted; never oversized or multi-region dominant
Rare.intent: premium AoT-style chase piece below future Legendary/Mythic complexity

Mythic: subtle animation or VFX where appropriate

avoid: exact Survey Corps or other copied faction insignia
oversized Rare emblems that consume the garment
Rare compositions using every available region
